title: Laredo Public Health Joins Healthcare Leaders at Chamber's 'Coffee with the Chairman'
excerpt: Laredo Public Health Director Dr. Richard A. Chamberlain joined fellow local healthcare leaders for the Laredo Chamber of Commerce's 'Coffee with the Chairman' discussion on the current state of healthcare in Laredo.
content:
Laredo Public Health took part in the Laredo Chamber of Commerce's "Coffee with the Chairman" event on Tuesday, joining a leadership discussion on "The Current State of Healthcare."

Public Health Director Dr. Richard A. Chamberlain joined Jorge Leal, chief executive officer of Laredo Medical Center and chairman of the Laredo Chamber of Commerce; Elmo Lopez Jr., chief executive officer of Gateway Community Health Center; and Oliver Ostorga, chief executive officer of Doctors Hospital of Laredo.

Together, the four leaders discussed the challenges and opportunities facing Laredo's healthcare system, including improving access to care, addressing community needs and strengthening collaboration among local healthcare providers.

The discussion comes as Laredo continues to grow, with local leaders working to make sure residents have access to the healthcare services they need.

Source: Laredo Public Health, Nov. 18, 2026.
